scenario_description:
Objective: Use a same-day manufacturer registration bonus to add no-cost corrosion coverage to a replacement bilge switch being kept aboard.
Emerging Need: The purchase and preview only show a possible future offer; later observations confirm the item will be installed, qualifies, and has a short submission window.
Decision Context: The service workpad holds the assigned serial, counter-invoice reference, registration inbox, and no-paid-plan preference, distinguishing a reversible free registration from warranty upgrades or replacement orders.
Consequence: Timely registration could improve future claim options; ignoring it leaves the switch, installation plan, and standard warranty unchanged, and after closure the bonus cannot be added.

parameter.description: Personal purchase completion for reserved RuleMate automatic bilge switch counter invoice.

parameter.subject: Fall registration bonus preview for pump-switch owners
parameter.body: GuardWave will open a limited fall registration bonus later today for some newly purchased pump and bilge-switch models. Eligible product families and submission instructions will be posted after inventory review; early submissions are not being accepted.

parameter.title: Install replacement bilge switch at slip
parameter.description: Swap in the reserved Oarlock Marine switch if tonight's bench test checks out; keep the standard receipt packet with the service notes.

parameter.content: Bench test worked on the RuleMate switch from Oarlock, so it is staying aboard for tomorrow morning's install. No return errand needed.

parameter.subject: Today only: RM-2000 qualifies for no-cost corrosion coverage add-on
parameter.body: The RM-2000 automatic bilge-switch family is eligible for today's free corrosion-coverage registration add-on. Submit the product serial and purchase invoice reference through the registration desk by 15:00 Pacific today. No purchase of a service plan is required; standard one-year warranty coverage remains unchanged if no submission is made.

parameter.subject: Fall corrosion add-on registration window closed
parameter.body: The no-cost corrosion-coverage add-on window for today's eligible RM-2000 registrations closed at 15:00 Pacific. Late submissions and retroactive additions are not available; standard warranty terms continue for unregistered bonus claims.
